town_description: Hoshiarpur is a historic city of Punjab's Doaba region in the Shivalik foothills. Pilgrims from Hoshiarpur commonly travel to the Kangra valley Shaktipeeths of Himachal Pradesh (Bajreshwari Devi at Kangra ~70-75 km, Jwalamukhi, Chamunda Devi), which may explain the CSV's association of the name with Hoshiarpur.
tradition: Hinduism (Shaktism - assumed from the name, unverified locally)

travel.airport: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport, Amritsar (~140 km); Chandigarh International Airport (~140 km); Gaggal Airport, Kangra (~13 km from Kangra town) if visiting the Kangra Shaktipeeth.
travel.railway: Hoshiarpur railway station (small station; Jalandhar City ~40 km is the nearest major railhead); Pathankot (~90 km) is the nearest broad-gauge railhead for Kangra.
travel.road: Hoshiarpur city is on the Hoshiarpur-Chandigarh road; the Kangra Shaktipeeth is ~70-75 km away on the Kangra-Hoshiarpur highway if the CSV intends that temple.
